Um homem vestido de casaco preto por cima de uma camisa social azul escura entrou no café, ele parecia comum, pele branca, olhos azuis, e estatura elevada, ele virou os olhos em procura de algo, um mordomo foi o atender, mas o homem respondeu:
"Ah, não estou aqui para comprar nada, estou procurando alguns....amigos."
Ele deu uma piscada descontraída para o  atendente, seu olho pareceu arregalar levemente enquanto o mordomo entendeu:
"Entendo, faça o que bem quiser."
O homem sorriu em resposta, e caminhou até o final do café, onde encontraria Gustavo Quid e Bella Rubim, ele fez um sorriso amigável e caloroso para ambos, e disse:
"Bom dia, eu venho os trazer... algo."
Os dois se entre olharam na mesa, Gustavo pensou:
"O que esse maluco aí quer hein? Não me diga que é um vendedor..."
Mas, a figura colocou um papel na mesa, era uma espécie de documento, ele apontou para ele, e disse:
"Soube que o CNT está caçando Tessitores, recomendo tomarem cuidado, serão tempos sombrios para gente como nós."
Bella pareceu confusa com oque o homem disse, e questionou, após tomar um gole de café .
"O que cê tá querendo hein?!"
Ela parecia exigente, o homem sorriu, uma mecha de seu cabelo loiro cobriu seu olho, que ele ajustou.
"Ah sim, não se preocupe, não tenho interesse algum em ferir vocês, mas, sinto que deveria avisar vocês por isso, afinal, a vida daqueles como nos, tessitores acabou de ficar ainda mais difícil..."
Gustavo com uma pitada de irritação disse:
"Ei para de ficar enrolando e diz logo o que você quer!"
O homem manteve um olhar sereno e seu sorriso, seus olhos brilharam um pouco, enquanto ele explicava:
Eu me expressei mal, admito, eles já [i]estão[/i] caçando, uma operação que chamam ... Áspero."
Ele abaixou o tom da voz, como se fosse algo confidencial.
"Eles agora estão rastreando e mapeando Tessitores, agentes eneritae espreitam, e coletam informações, com certeza há algum deles aqui agora mesmo!"
Gustavo agarrou com força o copo de café, como se fosse jogar ele no homem misterioso, mas Bella o acalmou pondo a mão sob seu antebraço, ele apenas disse:
"E quem você é afinal? Como sabe disso? [i]quem é você?[/i]"
O homem manteve o tom sereno e calmo, e o respondeu:
"Ah, bem, eu me chamo Samuel, e por que disso?Pois é sempre bom a usar, não acha? Quem avisa amigo é, como diz o ditado, eles não vão mais enviar seu heróico Raul, se enviarem será para capturar, e..."
Ele deu de ombros em um gesto casual, e entregou um pequeno bilhete com uma caveira vermelha desenhada e duas com uma cartola no topo e olhos azul e dourado, ele apenas disse antes de partir.
"...e o Revolucionário e nós mandamos lembranças, e um abraço."
Ele piscou antes de sair ajustando o casaco, deixando a proposta pairar no ar, Gustavo levantou os braços para cima, em um protesto claro.
"Ah qualé e agora oque a gente faz??? Temos que escolher um dos dois!"
Enquanto Gustavo estava indeciso, sua companheira , Rubim pensava na proposta, com um interesse claro, mas também em dúvidas sobre."
[/Spoiler]

Communism, it was a word that wasnt unknown to the equines of Equestria, however, it certainly wasnt a word which was too well received, at least not in its purest form. It had once tried to come into Equestria, and had nearly succeeded in overturning the government, however, it failed thanks to pressure from the government of Thýven in the early 30s. However, the word popped up once again, and it had popped up in the place of Sanguivallis, a large state on the white strait, and then it popped up in Astanir. However, there would be no large condemnation from the Equestrian government, nor would they mention it beyond hushed whispers within the Bureau of Investigations, whose eyes as of recent had been turned towards the constitutional crisis in Thýven. 

The Constitutional Crisis of Thýven was an odd occurrence in that particular region of the world, Thýven rarely had crises, but it had now presented itself as an unstable state, unable to hold together even the most basic of unions. With the collapse of Elesyr-Vespurias and the presence of communism, Equestria sat in limbo, caught almost between two worlds. However, to the opportunistic diarchate of the crown of Equestria, the matter held great importance, a chance to perhaps move away from the heavy handed grasp of Thýven and into a more self-deterministic realm. The cards were now in Equestrias hand, so what would they do?

[b]The Chamber of the Princes: Bělokvětov Castle[/b]

The situation on Elseyr is most perilous brother, it is almost as if the continent is being torn into two pieces, the speaker was prince Wenceslaus of Equestria, a blonde maned, white furred equine with kindly blue eyes, his gaze was turned upon his brother, Karel, co-ruler of the principate, and it was he whom the matter was addressed.

Concerning reports come out of Thýven every day, regarding the situation there, nothing too unstable, but the government seems reluctant to re-establish order, I always knew that the two kingdoms of the strait uniting was a bad idea, replied Karel, not really addressing what his brother had said.

Wenceslaus coughed slightly, rising from his haunches and moving to where his brother was, It is not Thýven that I am worried about, they always pull through, it is us that I am worried aboutwe are landlocked, weak, and susceptible to whatever hell decides to throw at us,

What then do you propose? replied Karel, turning his hazel eyes to his brother, You are aware we are still bound to the treaties of 1656, 1704, and 1838, treaties which he was cut off by his brother.

Yes, yes, treaties which bind us to Thýven, but, what happens if Thýven is not present in our affairs, I mean should something come through, someone even! We might as well lay down and die, replied Wenceslaus.

Very well, what do you propose? continued Karel, repeating the question which his brother had ignored initially.

Look, the deck is in our hooves, I say we expand our eyes outwards, perhaps the Montfleurois will be able to aid us in giving us a more expansive grasp of the world, connections, replied Wenceslaus.

Karel snorted, The Montfleurois? Surely you do not want us to ask those liberal prissies to make deals with us, Id sooner make a deal with the Neue Republik, or whatever its called now, 

Well, you get my point, replied Wenceslaus, We need to expand our horizons, just in case the treaties of 1656, 1704, and 1838 do not hold up with whatever regime comes into play in Thýven.

[spoiler=[b]Reorganization and shifts[/b]]

[i]With the withdrawal of Nordiheim and the Argossian militias from the lower islands, the UDF was swift to seize the territories and reorganize there. Now being positioned in between a Daesunesian leased military base in Maqamistan and the rest of Astanir, the UDF was in the perfect position to continue its island hopping offensive. But first, she'd lick her wounds. The fierce struggle with the Argossians left hundreds of UDF soldiers dead and depleted almost all of their current ordinance and ammo reserves. Over the next couple days, ammo shipments and medical supplies from third party unknown sources vaguely tracing to Daesun were delivered to the island, where UDF soldiers hospitalised their wounded and reloaded their armaments. Meanwhile, a multi-layered operation was conducted in search of missing in action combatants, decentralised search teams were dispatched to specific sectors of the islands to find their missing comrades, but if a soldier wasn't found after 7 days they'd be declared dead.

But even with surplus intermission, the UDF's search for its next victim continued. Northeast to the lower islands was a larger island controlled by the Restorationists which was suspected to be the faction's arms depot. Knowing their war machine needed more fuel, and had become more dependent on Daesun, the UDF decided after further discussion with Daesunesian high command and approval that their next military operations would be situated there. 

The first and essential phase for an attack on the restorationists was proper intelligence on the terrain, weapons situations, and positions. Which is what the UDF specialized in, over the next couple days, small surveillance drones were dispatched over the island in faint hordes, snapping instantaneous photos and videos of the island which would be up linked to the PDF and UDF high command. Though with such a short deadline, the UDF could only make blunt work of its captured intelligence. The next couple days were spent relaying this data with Daesun, whod translate it into missile launch coordinates for UDF ballistic missile systems stationed in the lower archipelago. Once codes were initialized and ready, the UDFs ballistic missile armada roared to life. Multiple Shahab-3 ballistic missile systems steamed their hatches open, releasing a volley of missiles towards restorationist military assets, positions, and general headquarters, 20 missiles soared across the clouds towards their targets, prowling with decisive speed. But the assault wasnt over yet, simultaneously, hundreds of suicide loitering drones zipped across the vast seas, saturating the Shahabs radar signature with their colossal hordes. These drones mainly focused on either precision strikes on aerial defences and political nodes, with their power coming in their sheer numbers. 

The UDFs focus was catching the restorationists off guard, to buy enough time for their amphibious assault force. Hundreds of marines seasoned from the fighting with the Argossian militias deployed towards the island in LCUs and LCACs, while also seeking an aerial escort of 3 Daesunesian F-15s, accompanied by another 6 F-18s. In total, over 3,500 soldiers headed towards the restorationist stronghold, ready for a battle that decisively ensured whether the UDF would succeed Astanir or not. Defeat was not an option, but a deterrent. 

Meanwhile, the UDF had also kept a keen eye on the current tableflip that was the rapidly shifting borders of mainland Astanir. Concerned by the rapid gains of Pax Intl, as well as the capturing of the capital, the UDF veered its head towards any potential beneficiary willing to combat Pax Intl expansion. One that caught the UDFs eye was isolationists, though a political contrast to the ideals of the UDF, the isolationists were their best bet to stalling off Pax Intl.  The UDF would reach out to the isolationists, offering military equipment such as ammo, anti-ship batteries, tanks, SAMs, and more. While requesting a temporary truce be signed between the two factions to establish a sort of common ground for their shared animosity for Pax Intl. The first efforts to flesh this out were in the form of invites to Teremok for negotiations and discussions. 

But for Teremok, her stake in the war seemed to be reckless and more decisive. The UDF still wasnt trustworthy enough to be able to function on its own without Daesunesian fostering, and so Daesun decided to privately take part in the UDFs assault on the restorationists. Eager to test out its new E/A-18G electronic warfare aircraft, an assault on the heavily armed restorationists was the perfect simulation for Daesun. In accordance with the UDF, Daesunesian E-18s flew from airbases in the lower archipelago towards the restorationist force, once within range, they utilized their electronic warfare specialized frame to turn the electronic battlefield into a conundrum of electronic noise, which aimed at further disorienting restorationist radars for the UDFs assault. The planes continued to loiter across the coast, defended by F-15s and F-18s orbiting them. [/i][/spoiler]
